question.text: What is the minimum continuing interest required from the Manager or Sponsor in a Category III AIF?

answer.text: 5% of the corpus or Rs 10 crores, whichever is lower
5% of the corpus or Rs 5 crores, whichever is lower
2.5% of the corpus or Rs 5 crores, whichever is lower
10% of the corpus or Rs 20 crores, whichever is lower

explanation.text: The Logic: For Category III AIFs, the continuing interest required from the Manager or Sponsor is 5% of the corpus or Rs 10 crores, whichever is lower. The Trap: 2.5% of the corpus or Rs 5 crores, whichever is lower, is the continuing-interest requirement for Category I and II AIFs, not Category III. Note: Category III AIFs may use diverse or complex trading strategies and leverage; the Category III continuing-interest rule sits within the AIF Regulations alongside the separate Category I and II thresholds.
